description: This PHP class defines the LeaveBalance entity in the OrangeHRM system, encapsulating leave entitlement, usage, scheduled, pending, taken leave, and balance calculations with associated getters and setters.

classes.name: LeaveBalance
classes.description: Represents a leave balance with properties like entitlement, used, scheduled, pending, taken leave, and methods to compute and retrieve the current balance.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes LeaveBalance with optional values and calculates the initial balance.

methods.name: updateBalance
methods.description: Recalculates the leave balance based on current properties and configuration.

methods.name: getAsAtDate
methods.description: Returns the date at which the entitlement data is relevant.

methods.name: getYmdAsAtDate
methods.description: Returns the 'YYYY-MM-DD' formatted string of asAtDate.

methods.name: setAsAtDate
methods.description: Sets the date at which the entitlement data is relevant.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the entitlement period.

methods.name: getYmdEndDate
methods.description: Returns the 'YYYY-MM-DD' formatted string of endDate.

methods.name: setEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the entitlement period.
